==Overview==
* Imperial treasury during this season announced by the Civil Service at 397 thrones and 2 crowns.
* The following has been donated to the Imperial treasury:
** 28 thrones donated to the treasury by '''Severin Teyhard von Holberg''', Acting Prince of the House of Seven Mirrors after the Summer Solstice 383YE
** 10 thrones donated to the treasury by the Chapter Reumah's Redoubt after the Summer Solstice 383YE

===Announcements===
* Hand of the Chancellor: The Throne exercised her power of Hand of the Chancellor to withdraw no (zero) funds from this season’s residual income (Zero Thrones) to the Imperial Treasury.
* The Throne announced through her power of [[The_Throne#Address_the_Empire|Voice of the Empire]] that [[General]] Gabriel Barossa shall address the Empire following the Summer Solstice of 383YE.
* The [[Keeper of the Breadbasket]] announced that they would spread the bounty of the breadbasket across Mitwold, Upwold, and Bregasland, to strengthen Marcher traditions.
* The [[Minister of Historical Research]] announced a project to [[Research the origins of the Highborn]]
* The [[Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies]] announced that the Guerdon would be applied to the following armies for the coming season: the raid on Ikka’s Tears, the Green Shield, the Red Wind Corsairs, the Tusks, the Granite Pillar, the Strong Reeds, and the Northern Eagle.
* [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave|Imperial Wayleave]]: Announcement by Tristan Exile’s End of intent to [[Construct Misericorde Market]].
* Imperial Wayleave: Announcement by Dragomir Dragovich of intent to [[Construct Iron Roundtower]]
* Imperial Orc Wayleave: Announcement by Palerictus Krunk of intent to [[Construct Smith of Ashes]].
